NOTICE OF ANNUAL MEETING OF STOCKHOLDERS To Be Held on December 14, 2016
Dear Stockholders of Axar Acquisition Corp.: The 2016 annual meeting of stockholders (the "Annual Meeting") of Axar Acquisition Corp., a Delaware corporation (the "Company"), will be held on December 14, 2016, at 10:00 a.m., local time, to consider and vote upon the following proposals: 1. To elect David Gong and P. Sue Perrotty as Class II directors to serve until the 2019 annual meeting of stockholders; 2. To ratify the appointment of WithumSmith+Brown as the Company's independent registered public accounting firm. The funds in the trust account will be distributed to public stockholders only upon a business combination or liquidation.
